facts.fact: The Eastern Regional Registrar of the Births and Deaths Registry says officers are expected to complete birth registrations digitally in communities and that poor internet connectivity is a major operational obstacle to doing so; the assembly member for Bepowase (Ayensuano District, about 3,000 people, no telecommunication network) says birth registration 'has been digitalised' and is very difficult there for want of a network. The document gives no date for this; dated from its published date, itself a proxy.
